detailed_description:
Uncover her erotic side with a drone and a vibrator!

■Note■

In the trial version, even if you touch the woman with the vibrator, she will not react at all. Also, touching the menu will have no effect, so please be aware of this. Please think of this as a drone and vibrator control test, or as a test of this app's operation. Thank you.

Since verbal communication with the female characters is important on this game, it is best to select "Japanese" as the play language if possible. Although it is possible to play in "English", please note that it is not the girls' native language.

■Content■

Make full use of a drone and a Hitachi(vibrator) to get her in an erotic mood.

Basically, the vibrator acts as your hand. That means you have to touch her with the vibrator, press the menu with the vibrator, etc.

We have prepared three girls: Nako, Shuri, and Akiko.

It will start off with normal eroticism with the girl. When her eroticism reaches its peak, the girl is cleared. On the other hand, if she becomes disillusioned with your caresses, the game will be over.

Each girl has a different area of ​​sensitivity, order, and timing, so the way her eroticism changes also differs.

The areas that react to touch are the head, chest area, right buttocks and groin, left buttocks and groin, right thigh, and left thigh (each spherical reactive area is covered with a thin gray line).

The trick to increasing her eroticism is to listen carefully to what she says and touch her gently. It's better to touch her gently from the side or back, especially around her crotch or buttocks, as there is a chance that multiple areas will be touched at the same time.

The more information you can get from her, the closer you'll be to clearing the level. Sometimes they will have something meaningful to say, and other times they will just tell you the barometer or the erotic point of how sexy mood they are.

There are ending and game over short videos for each woman, but please note that they contain images of urine, enemas, and scat. If you find these disturbing, please close your eyes and just listen to the background musics.

■Change the Girl or the Level■

You can change the girl or the level from the menu board on the left side of the drone.

The displayed girls are as follows, with the girls and the flight modes available from the top being aimed at beginners, and the difficulty level increasing as you go down.

You can choose the flight mode in parentheses. Velocity mode provides stable flight. Please note that Acro mode is difficult.

Nako (Velocity mode, Air mode, Cine mode) (Nako + Filming drone: for beginners, the first girl you will see is her)

Shuri (Angle mode, Air mode, Acro mode) (Shuri + FPV drone: for intermediate users)

Akiko (Angle mode, Air mode, Acro mode) (Akiko + FPV drone: for advanced users)

Exit (End game)

■How to operate the drones and Hitachi(Vibrator)■

They can be operated with a general game controller connected via USB or a keyboard.

After starting the game, use either device to automatically recognize it.

Operation instructions are displayed directly on the game screen.

The Hitachi(Vibrator) will basically be positioned in the direction of the drone's nose. You cannot move it alone, it always moves according to the movement of the drone. Please be aware of this.

■Settings■

During the game, you can change various settings or reset the game by pressing the "Start" button on the game controller or the "ESC" key on the keyboard.

Settings (Settings)

Reset Level (Reset the game)

■How to use■

■Operating environment■

< exe file for Windows >

Tested to work on 9th generation Core i5, 32GB RAM, RTX4070TiSuper, Windows 10. Please use with the equivalent or higher specs.

Basically, a gaming PC with mid-range specs or higher is required.
